The Fleet

The right vehicle changes what a day can hold

01

Mercedes V-Class

The core of every Adrion journey. The V-Class has the space for a family or a small group to travel without compression — luggage, equipment, silence and sightlines. It handles Split's airport runs and Biokovo's approach roads with the same composure. This is the vehicle that becomes the moving base when the itinerary is ambitious.

02

Mercedes E-Class

For two people, or for the moments in a journey that call for a different register. The E-Class is the executive transfer, the couples arrival, the discreet conveyance when the occasion is quiet and the party is small. Precise, understated, unremarkable to anyone watching — which is the point.

03

Custom Mercedes Sprinter

Built for larger groups and for the logistics that come with them. The Sprinter carries extended families, corporate parties and the gear that active journeys accumulate. Custom-configured for comfort over distance, not utility. When the journey has eight people and four sets of bikes, the Sprinter holds it all without compromise.

04

High-end full-suspension e-MTBs

The active line. Full-suspension, high-end electric mountain bikes with the assist calibrated for the ascents they are built for — Biokovo, Cetina, the interior tracks above the Makarska coast. A support vehicle shadows every ride. The bikes extend what the day can reach; the vehicle makes sure the ride remains optional for anyone who wants to observe rather than climb.

Land & Sea

Land & Sea Transfers

Travelling along the Croatian coast does not always have to happen by road. Where it makes sense, we combine luxury Mercedes transfers with private speedboat transfers — faster, more scenic and entirely personalised.

01

Private Speedboat Transfers

A fast, private crossing between coastal towns and islands — your own boat, your own schedule, the open Adriatic in place of the coastal road.

02

Island Connections

Direct links to Hvar, Brač, Vis and the quieter islands, timed to your day rather than to a ferry timetable.

03

Combined Land & Sea Journeys

A Mercedes to the marina, a speedboat across the water, a driver waiting on the far side — one unbroken line from door to destination.

Every sea transfer can be integrated into your customised Adrion itinerary — whether it is a day journey, a multi-day experience or a private yacht charter. How our transfers work →
